name: 御风符
subject: One sage-green Chinese paper wind talisman, short broad vertical paper strip with two angular wind-swept torn corners, thick pale paper edge, one bold ochre curling wind glyph formed from large square steps. Small dark green top fold. Three green shades and muted gold symbol. No pendant chain, waving smoke or intricate writing.

name: 隐身符
subject: One slate-blue folded paper stealth talisman. Compact asymmetrical paper rectangle with one corner folded toward viewer, pale cyan broken-outline angular glyph shaped like a disappearing figure. One broad shadow fold, dark blue sealing tab at top. Entire object solid opaque paper with transparent background; not a glass bottle or blurry ghost.

name: 火符
subject: One warm cream Chinese paper fire talisman at slight diagonal, broad thick paper strip, single large vermilion stepped flame-shaped ink seal, dark red band folded across top, two small scorched square notches along lower paper edge. Limited flat tan shades; no real flame, glow, detailed calligraphy or tiny sparks.

name: 雷符
subject: One ivory paper thunder talisman, long broad angular paper strip with folded lower corner, a single bold deep-blue zigzag thunder ink seal running down center, navy folded top band and small gold square seal near bottom. Large square pixel clusters, no real electric arcs or spark effects.

name: 归乡符
subject: One paired homing-paper talisman: two short cream paper strips joined by a thick red cord across their tops, left strip bears a big muted green doorway glyph, right strip bears a simple curved return mark. Small gap between strips; blocky paper edges, three paper shades. No miniature landscape, map, text or many thin cord loops.

name: 金刚符
subject: One triangular folded ochre-gold paper vajra talisman, thick layered paper corners and one bold dark brown protective shield-like seal in its center. A short red folded paper tab at top. Clearly a folded paper charm, not a metal shield or jewel. Coarse hard-edged squares, three paper tones, no filigree.

name: 摄魂符
subject: One muted violet paper soul-capturing talisman, broad vertical strip with a stepped double-notched lower edge, a single large pale ochre angular binding-knot sigil in center and one folded dark purple header. Plain paper with a clear thick left edge. No skull face, ghosts, glow or chains.
